flavor: Thousands of hollowed glass needles hang from the ceiling by translucent threads, swaying in a breeze that seems to originate from nowhere. As the air currents shift, the needles collide, producing a haunting, polyphonic melody that vibrates in the marrow of your bones.
name: The Aeolian Chime-Garden
reason: The room serves as a sonic landmark for navigation, using wind patterns to signal the proximity of larger atmospheric currents in the dungeon.
